description:
The AVX2 $\mathbb{F}_7$ packed kernels perform byte-pair LUT lookups as scalar loads per `u64` inside each AVX2 register. A gather-based lookup is an untested alternative.

## Background

`crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/bipedal/packed7.rs` and `crate::x86::bipedal_avx2_packed7` hold the kernels. The module documentation named the gather form as deferred work; the source-comment sweep removed that statement, and this issue tracks it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A gather-based AVX2 lookup for the $\mathbb{F}_7$ packed kernels is implemented behind the existing dispatch with the scalar-LUT path as its tested fallback, or a committed receipt records that it does not improve on the scalar-LUT path and the candidate is dropped.
- [hard] REQ-02: Any implemented path passes the shared behavioral suite of the $\mathbb{F}_7$ packed kernels, including the word-boundary cases.
- [hard] REQ-03: The decision cites a committed benchmark receipt from the overnight benchmark window, per `@/inv/benchmark-backed-performance`.
title: Evaluate a gather-based AVX2 lookup for the F_7 packed kernels
